svg.text: M4(b) v1 · Owner A. Rivera · Published 2026-07-20 · one of 3 screens captured
WHAT WE ARE NOT COUNTING
· Onboarding time for 9 new engineers (no baseline yet)
· QA hours on system-built surfaces (tracking starts Q4)
· Brand-consistency effects on trust metrics
RISK AND BREACHES
Automated a11y pass rate on system surfaces: 96%, ▲ 3 pts (not a conformance claim).
Key-person: 2 of 5 critical areas have no named backup. ▼
Breach (M1): Admin console web coverage 58% → 41% over 28 days, since Aug 2.
Owner S. Lindqvist · cause: new vendor widget · open in the feed, escalated.
THE DECISION
Hold current headcount through Q1; approve the Android coverage instrumentation (10 eng-days).
If no: Android stays unmeasured; the 80% target applies to web only and the December read-out will say so.
